title: Come Snuggle by the Fireplace: 1 Hour of Crackling Fire for Deep Sleep | Mateo's Fireplace
description:
AI-generated fictional persona. Not affiliated with UNM.

Come snuggle by the fireplace. Watch FIGHT and FLIGHT melt into REST and DIGEST, then let the fire take it from there.

One hour of soft crackling fire with a warm low drone that swells and settles at six breaths a minute (4 seconds in, 6 seconds out), a pace often used to help the body downshift into rest. No talking, no music drops. The tones bow out in the last few minutes and the fire carries you the rest of the way.

All sound and picture made from scratch by Sandoval Studios. Goodnight.
